name: AI Agent
description: Agent LLM con tool-calling y memoria al estilo n8n. Conecta herramientas al puerto 'Tools', memoria al puerto 'Memory' y (opcional) un nodo de Modelo al puerto 'Model'.

properties.name: model
properties.description: Se usa si no hay modelo conectado al puerto Model

properties.name: systemPrompt
properties.default: You are a helpful AI agent that can use tools when needed.

properties.name: toolsNotice
properties.default: Conecta nodos Tool al puerto 'Tools' o pásalos por entrada.

properties.name: memoryNotice
properties.default: Conecta un nodo Memory al puerto 'Memory', o usa input.history (Chat Trigger).

properties.name: historyWindow
properties.description: Número de pares user+assistant a cargar del historial

properties.name: toolChoice
properties.description: Forzar no usar herramientas o permitir auto tool-calling

properties.name: jsonMode
properties.description: Forzar respuestas JSON cuando el modelo lo soporte

properties.name: autoSave
properties.description: Persist user and assistant messages to chat storage when chatId/sessionId are present. Skips if request already persisted via API.
